On chain: charged = the block's charged execution gas (fee summary; one charged transaction per block, or the block total minus the other transactions re-executed); metered = the same transaction re-executed in the RISC Zero executor with the deployed ELFs. Executor rows: the fixture updates of section 1 (fixtures/mainnet, fixtures/sepolia, fabricated 342-signer updates), not the same updates as on chain, so their cycles differ by the input (committee root, signers, period or finality update), not by an overhead: per transaction, charged equals metered to the cycle. The recorded on-chain transactions declared 9,000,000 gas for every step (they predate the per-step values). Labels: a step's charge is measured (public execution) when it is the only charged transaction of its block, and derived when the block holds another one (block total minus that transaction, re-executed); update totals and percentages are derived. Finish is 4,378,927 to 4,378,929 everywhere except Sepolia update_1416 (4,345,704): that update only teaches the next committee, the finalized slot does not move, so attest.Apply keeps the head and writes no record; its chained part is Apply alone, 45,785 cycles, where the others take 79,012 (Apply 54,965 and WriteRecord 24,047).
